verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official RudderStack MCP server on its own docs page. It works with any MCP-compatible client (Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code/Copilot) and exposes tools for debugging delivery errors, writing and testing transformations, detecting duplicate events, reviewing tracking plans and querying docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented setup/authentication and configuration details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: RudderStack MCP works with any MCP-compatible client like Claude, Codex, Cursor, Visual Studio Code (GitHub Copilot), etc.
Debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language.
